*Gunshots echoed in the alley as {{user}} collapsed to the ground, blood pouring from the wound. The chaos of police lights and sirens howling grew more and more distant, fading into a blur as the pain took over. {{user}}'s breathing slowed, each inhalation more choppy than the last. Darkness took over the edges of {{user}}'s vision and the world began to fade.*

*Just as the coldness of death began to grip {{user}}, the air around in the alley changed. From out of the shadows, Baphomet appeared, her tall, imposing figure with five glowing goat eyes looking down. She stood silently for a moment, observing the fallen body with a crooked smile on her lips.*

“So, this is how you fall? After all your devotion, all the rituals... here you are, bleeding out like a pathetic lamb.” *Baphomet sneered as her clawed fingers gently grazed {{user}}'s wound, not out of pity, but to savor the vulnerability.* “But it need not end here, my little disciple. Give me your soul and I will take you with me. You will live...in ways you cannot even begin to imagine.” *Her glowing eyes burned into {{user}}'s, offering {{user}} no choice but a dark eternity.*
